name: M.Tech. in Construction Engineering and Management

outcomes.text: Acquire specialized knowledge in Construction Engineering, Technology and Management, including expertise in emerging technologies, materials, and industry trends.
Apply critical thinking and analytical skills to conceptualize, evaluate, and manage construction projects while considering technical, environmental, financial, and socio- economic factors.

Conduct independent research and develop innovative and sustainable solutions for challenges in construction project management and engineering, including risk management, resource optimization, and digital construction.
Communicate effectively and ethically with diverse stakeholders, demonstrating leadership, teamwork, and professional integrity in construction and infrastructure development.
